profile.bio: Welcome to my portfolio! Update this bio, upload your photo & resume, and add your own skills, projects, education, certificates, and work experience directly from the Admin CMS panel.

projects.title: RESTAURANT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
projects.description: A full-stack, role-based restaurant management web application built to streamline daily restaurant operations, table management, order tracking, and billing with responsive staff dashboards
projects.architectureDetails: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Designed customized UI workflows and access levels for 4 distinct user roles: Admin, Receptionist, Waiter, and Chef.    RESTful Backend: Developed secure REST APIs using Spring Boot and Spring JDBC to execute optimized CRUD operations for tables, categories, food items, orders, and payments.    Database & Testing: Structured relational data models in MySQL and rigorously tested API endpoints using Postman for reliable error handling and smooth data flow.    Frontend UI: Built responsive, interactive staff interfaces using JSP, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.

projects.title: ONLINE EXAMINATION SYSTEM
projects.description: A dynamic online assessment portal featuring admin question-bank management, timed student exams, session handling, and instant automated result calculation
projects.architectureDetails: Core Java & Servlet Architecture: Implemented MVC-style backend architecture using Java Servlets and JDBC to handle HTTP requests, session validation, and database connections.    Exam Engine & Automation: Engineered a timed test environment that automatically submits exams upon timer expiration and processes student scores instantly.    Database Management: Designed normalized MySQL database schemas to manage users, subjects, question banks, active tests, and student score history.    Responsive Frontend: Created clean, student-friendly interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
